title: Playing with Fats Domino and Harrison
summary: Dejan says Fats Domino played with him and speaks of working with Harrison.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: I wanted to ask you about Fats Domino, did you ever play with him? No, no, Fats Domino.
I know he played with lots of guys and Gano was always talking about.

Yeah, he played with me, but it was Bretton or Harold, you said, you know me, Harold, I mean Harrison. I worked with Harrison. Harrison, me and Harrison was like that, and Harrison was doing the pressure, that's what he was getting on. Harrison from Tonga to Tonga. Harrison was doing the pressure, and Harrison would tell you about it, he could play much beyond his eye, but he'd bring him out, you know, and play over there. I mean I don't cut any of the goods.
